original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情蔓延至与中非共和国接壤的新省份
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据两名卫生官员向路透社透露，刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情已蔓延至与中非共和国接壤的北乌班吉省，该省成为刚果第八个受病毒影响的省份。刚果当局尚未正式宣布这一新情况。官员称北乌班吉已记录两例病例。

location.raw_text: North Ubangi, at the border with the Central African Republic

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情据报蔓延至与中非共和国接壤的北乌班吉省
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to a new province at the border with the Central African Republic, according to two health officials who have spoken to Reuters.

key_facts.fact: 北乌班吉成为刚果第八个受埃博拉病毒影响的省份
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two cases had been recorded in North Ubangi, making it the eighth Congolese province affected by the virus

key_facts.fact: 北乌班吉已记录两例病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two cases had been recorded in North Ubangi

key_facts.fact: 刚果当局尚未宣布这一新情况
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The new development has not yet been announced by Congolese authorities.

uncertainties: 疫情蔓延至北乌班吉省的消息尚未获刚果当局正式宣布
